moat: India branded franchise
Moderate
#9-10 in the IPM, 25 brands above Rs100 cr, out-grew the IPM in FY26 (12.1% vs 9.9% MAT) and Q1FY27 (14.6% vs 13.5% MQT); in-licensed innovation (toripalimab Rs100 cr+), vaccines #2
Not a top-five player; growth leans on in-licensing and acquired brands (Progynova, Stugeron)
Emerging markets (Russia, CIS, RoW)
Moderate
Present in 48 countries; Russia Rs903 cr a quarter; 129 launches in FY26 re-using the US portfolio
Russia grew below its market (10.9% vs 15.2%); sanctions and rouble risk
US generics
Weak
79 filings pending, 24 possible first-to-files; bosutinib and sugammadex first-to-market in 2026
Price-taker; CEO admits R&D failures (iron sucrose, conjugated estrogens, late peptides); base ~US$950 mn a year vs ~US$1 bn in FY22
Vertical integration in complex APIs (peptides)
Moderate
In-house synthetic semaglutide API (300+ capacity units, up to 550 theoretical); supplies other generic makers; PSAI CDMO
The Jul-2026 scale-up failure shows execution risk; backup supplier is a year away
Biosimilars
Early
Abatacept (first Orencia biosimilar filing), rituximab approved in the US (Aug-2026), denosumab in Europe
~US$100 mn of sales and loss-making until abatacept launches
Consumer health (NRT)
Moderate
Nicotinell is the #2 NRT brand outside the US; growing high single digit to low double digit
Bought, not built (GBP458 mn); OTC competition
Balance sheet
Strong
Net cash Rs3,057 cr at Jun-2026; ICRA AA+ (Stable)
Gross borrowings Rs7,195 cr held against gross cash Rs9,151 cr
critiques: The ex-gRevlimid US base has settled at ~US$900 mn a year, near our bear case; consensus downgrades will continue and semaglutide/abatacept are already in the price
Q1 adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.3% shows a structurally lower margin profile than the high-teens to 20% the street expected post-gRevlimid
US base revenue was ~US$1 bn in FY22 and annualises at ~US$950 mn now despite 90-100 launches and the Mayne deal: where has growth gone?
IIFL analyst on the Q1FY27 call; CEO: 'your analysis is correct'
We failed in certain complex generics (iron sucrose, conjugated estrogen, late peptides)
FY27 is a transition year; earnings fall before reviving in FY28 with semaglutide and b-abatacept
Q1 was a disruption, not a change in the longer-term opportunity
gaps: gRevlimid (lenalidomide) sales and profit were never disclosed by year, so an ex-gRevlimid forward P/E median cannot be computed from sourced data (PLAYBOOK §7c allows it only as a sensitivity when sourced).

Methods, ratings and EPS of the global brokers (Goldman Sachs, Macquarie, CLSA, Morgan Stanley, UBS, JPMorgan, BNP, Investec, Citi, Jefferies, Nomura) and of Nuvama and JM Financial come only from press reports; their notes were not retrieved.

Semaglutide net price by market, the split of pens between Canada, India and B2B partners, and the US vs Canada split of North America revenue are not disclosed; our semaglutide revenue is an estimate built on management's 6-7 mn pens and US$25-30+ per pen.
India Ratings/Fitch rating action of 21-Jul-2026: details not retrieved (ICRA AA+ Stable reaffirmed Jan-2026).
